name: Gothic Horror
definition: A place, lineage, or institution makes buried history physically and emotionally present, trapping characters between inherited power, forbidden knowledge, and uncertain supernatural agency.
negative_signals: fear arising only from modern pursuit
diagnostic_questions: Does setting embody a history characters cannot simply leave behind?
Does revelation deepen both dread and human responsibility?

neighbors.distinction: Gothic horror roots uncertainty in place, inheritance, and material history.
A gothic threat often expresses buried relationships or institutions rather than ecology alone.

reader_promises.name: Haunted history
reader_promises.description: Make past harm exert present pressure through place, ritual, inheritance, or silence.

reader_promises.name: Atmospheric confinement
reader_promises.description: Use setting and social dependence to narrow choices before overt danger peaks.

roles.name: Inheritor or visitor
roles.description: Enters a legacy whose apparent privilege contains obligation or danger.

roles.name: Keeper of the house
roles.description: Maintains ritual, silence, property, or a protective version of history.

roles.name: Returning past
roles.description: Manifests suppressed injury through presence, repetition, evidence, or haunting.

conflicts: Desire for belonging versus need to escape
stakes: Ownership of home, body, or name
Repetition or acknowledgment of ancestral harm

movements.name: Arrival into legacy
movements.description: Bind the protagonist to a place or institution with an attractive and troubling history.

movements.name: Disturbance
movements.description: Let setting, records, or behavior contradict the accepted history.

movements.name: Unearthing
movements.description: Connect atmosphere to specific prior acts and present beneficiaries.

movements.name: Inheritance choice
movements.description: Resolve whether to expose, repair, destroy, accept, or repeat the legacy.

complications.name: Beneficial curse
complications.description: The harmful legacy also provides status, safety, intimacy, or power.

complications.name: Curated record
complications.description: Documents are genuine but preserved by someone shaping the historical account.

complications.name: Living repetition
complications.description: A present relationship begins reproducing the pattern being investigated.

twists.name: Haunting protects
twists.description: The frightening presence is preventing a worse repetition or guarding suppressed evidence.

twists.name: Heir manufactured
twists.description: Identity or succession was engineered to keep the institution intact.

conclusions.name: History acknowledged
conclusions.description: Truth becomes public or ritually recognized, changing ownership and memory.

conclusions.name: Legacy repeated
conclusions.description: The protagonist accepts benefit or denial and becomes the next keeper.

conclusions.name: Place repurposed
conclusions.description: The setting survives with altered access, meaning, or community control.

subversions: Let preservation rather than destruction repair the haunted place.
Give servants, neighbors, or excluded heirs authority over the history.
cliches_to_avoid: Mental illness used as a shorthand explanation for evil
quality_checks: Setting encodes specific power and history.
Revelations increase responsibility as well as information.
The ending changes the protagonist's relationship to inheritance.

sources.title: Popular Fiction and Brain Science in the Late Nineteenth Century
sources.contribution: Discusses gothic conventions, blurred genre boundaries, bodily anxiety, and historical social change.

sources.title: Making It Different: Pushing Genre Boundaries in Fantasy
sources.author_or_organization: Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association
sources.contribution: Supports transforming recognizable motifs instead of repeating stock settings and characters.
